title: Off-by-one index error in pagination loop
diff:
@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
 def get_page_items(items: list, page_size: int) -> list:
     chunks = []
-    for i in range(0, len(items), page_size):
-        chunks.append(items[i:i + page_size])
+    for i in range(len(items) + 1):
+        item = items[i]
+        chunks.append(item)
     return chunks

ground_truth.description: Loop iterates to len(items) + 1, raising IndexError when indexing items[len(items)].
